title: Authority Crosswalk & Organization/Dependent Taxonomy
objective: Reconcile followers, staff, hirelings, dependents, crews, businesses, organizations, factions, settlements, households and command structures with their existing canonical owners, and define which concepts are projections or relations rather than new ledgers.

red.failure: ODL-01 invariants and workspace-install passed on governed self-hosted lanes. Raw Linux client-typecheck then failed only with TS2307 for the intentionally missing authority-crosswalk-organization-dependent-taxonomy contract and OdlAuthorityCrosswalkPanel.

resolved_contract.crosswalk_rule: Each visible taxonomy entry carries explicit owner reference(s), owner authority id(s), representation kind, provenance and visibility evidence. ODL-01 records no owner truth of its own and never derives canonical ownership from a taxonomy label.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing owner evidence remains unknown; conflicting explicit confirmed/not-owner mappings remain conflict pending canonical-owner resolution; incompatible evidence remains incompatible.
resolved_contract.permission_rule: Organizational title, rank, membership, hierarchy or command position never implies system permission, action authority or autonomous command authority.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized entries and owner mappings are filtered before counts, search, projection summaries, provenance, receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.provenance_rule: Only explicit visible owner-mapping provenance is retained; provenance is never fabricated or inferred.
resolved_contract.capacity_rule: ODL-01 defines no universal follower cap, organization-size cap, capacity score, coordination load or growth-failure threshold.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable ODL-01 persistence, duplicate organization/resource/relationship ledger or migration 0022.
resolved_contract.production_scope: Read-only owner-reference crosswalk/taxonomy projection contract plus accessible nonvisual panel only.

preserved_boundaries: Canonical Organization/Faction/Relationship/Reputation, Character, Economy, Base/Vehicle, Project, DPL, WCI and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.
No owner-domain mutation, command authority, system permission, duplicate ledger, universal follower cap, capacity/load mechanics, durable persistence or migration 0022 was introduced.
ODL-02 is successor selection only; ODL-03+, SCL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
